source.version: Part 15 — Arthropod and Invertebrate Pests — Batch 02
source.publicationAuthorization: Project owner authorized continued website publication on 2026-09-01. Independent specialist approval remains a separate project-control field and is not implied by publication.
source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-286–290 were reconciled against direct Cannabis/hemp aphid and whitefly research plus current university greenhouse extension for fungus gnats and shore flies. Public wording separates pest identity from disease diagnosis and treatment authorization, distinguishes adult versus damaging immature stages, preserves cross-species evidence limits, and rejects universal cannabis action thresholds where not established.
source.note: This batch extends controlled Volume 15 with cannabis aphids, other aphids, whiteflies, fungus gnats, and shore flies.
